rules.note: Marathi: 'The farmer must have 7/12 (land record) in their own name.' Translation confirmed 2026-11-11. Joint-owner exception and tenant cases not encoded; caseworker. Plantation area limits (Konkan 0.10-10 ha, rest 0.20-6 ha) not encoded; caseworker.
Marathi: 'Not payable to institutional landholders/beneficiaries.' Translation confirmed 2026-11-11.

unresolved: Minimum and maximum plantation area differ by region (Konkan 0.10-10 ha, rest of Maharashtra 0.20-6 ha); needs a region fact.
Joint owners need the other owners' consent; a tenant's name on 7/12 needs the tenant's consent.
